content.value_statement: Data rights registration requires coordinated evidence, compliance, and legal review. This skill structures the work into roles, stages, deliverables, and quality checks.
actual_capabilities: Classifies data rights across holding, processing and use, and product operation.
Routes work among property, product, public data, intellectual property, and legal roles.
Structures a five-stage workflow from scope confirmation through final delivery.
Lists expected registration materials, evidence, review outputs, and renewal records.
Checks source legality, rights burdens, registration type, classification, and document consistency.
Distinguishes enterprise, data product, public data, and protection workflows.
limitations: The guidance focuses on Chinese policy and registration practices.
Local authority and exchange requirements must be confirmed for each filing.
The skill cannot issue certificates or guarantee approval, listing, financing, or registration.
A licensed lawyer must issue and sign any formal legal opinion.

use_cases.title: Assess enterprise data rights
use_cases.description: Map data sources, rights holders, burdens, and evidence before an accounting, financing, or transaction project.

use_cases.title: Prepare a data product filing
use_cases.description: Organize product definitions, descriptions, compliant samples, review materials, and filing responses.

use_cases.title: Review public data operations
use_cases.description: Separate resource registration from authorized operation and identify required agreements, assessments, and records.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a registration path
prompt_templates.prompt: Our organization holds [data description] from [sources]. Identify the likely registration path and the information needed before assessment.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner triage for an unfamiliar data asset

prompt_templates.title: Build an evidence checklist
prompt_templates.prompt: Create an evidence checklist for [data asset]. Cover source legality, rights holders, contracts, personal information, third-party rights, and security classification.

prompt_templates.title: Plan the registration project
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a phased registration plan for [goal and jurisdiction]. Assign roles, dependencies, deliverables, review gates, and renewal tracking.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a complete submission
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this proposed registration package: [summary]. Test rights conclusions against evidence, identify inconsistencies, and produce prioritized remediation actions.

output_examples.input: We created a customer analytics product from licensed transaction data and want registration.
output: Recommended path: assess data product registration after confirming the license permits processing and commercial use.
Evidence needed: source contracts, processing records, rights allocation, personal information controls, product description, and compliant sample data.
Review gate: do not submit until third-party rights and personal information obligations are resolved.

output_examples.input: A local authority wants to authorize operation of a public data resource.
output: Treat public data registration and authorized operation as separate procedures.
Confirm scope, classification, responsible entity, security assessment, authorization agreement, operating term, and local filing rules.
Obtain legal and compliance review before operational use.

output_examples.input: Check whether our registration package is ready.
output_examples.output: The readiness review identifies missing source evidence, unresolved rights burdens, inconsistent document statements, incomplete classification, and absent renewal ownership.

best_practices: Support every rights conclusion with specific source, contract, authorization, or processing evidence.
Resolve ownership and compliance issues before preparing registration or transaction materials.
Verify current local rules, forms, terms, and validity periods with the receiving authority.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a registration certificate as proof that all underlying rights are valid.
Do not promise approval, certification, exchange listing, financing, or commercial success.
Do not submit personal or third-party data before resolving consent, authorization, and protection requirements.

faq.question: Does registration create data ownership?
faq.answer: No. The skill states that registration provides public notice and does not cure defects in underlying rights.

faq.question: Can this skill guarantee a certificate?
faq.answer: No. Approval depends on evidence, compliance, jurisdiction, and the receiving authority.

faq.question: Can it produce a formal legal opinion?
faq.answer: It can structure review inputs and draft analysis. A licensed lawyer must issue and sign the formal opinion.

faq.question: Which registration routes are covered?
faq.answer: It covers enterprise data rights, data products, public data resources, and related intellectual property protection planning.

faq.question: Does it apply outside China?
faq.answer: The included policies and procedures focus on China. Other jurisdictions require separate legal and procedural research.

faq.question: What information should I provide first?
faq.answer: Provide the business goal, jurisdiction, data sources, processing history, contracts, rights claims, personal information status, and existing evidence.
